how.title: How it works
how.subtitle: From your question to a synthesized, decision-ready answer in four stages.

input.title: Bring your material
input.desc: Drop in documents (PDF, Word, slides), images (screenshots, diagrams) or a plain-language question of any complexity. Whatever you provide is treated as working context, not background noise.

enrich.title: Add the right context
enrich.desc: AI Delphi Council detects your intent, decides whether fresh research is needed, and pulls in real-time or reference context when your question depends on current evidence — intent detection, web search and deep research before any synthesis.

process.title: Council deliberation
process.desc: Three stages: each model first answers independently, then reviews and ranks the answers anonymously, and finally a chairman synthesizes a response that preserves consensus, dissent and caveats.

output.title: A synthesized answer
output.desc: You get a ranked, synthesized answer instead of a single-model guess — complete with confidence and disagreement signals and export-ready Word, PDF, PowerPoint or spreadsheet artifacts on request.

stage2.title: Stage 2: Peer rankings
stage2.desc: Each model evaluated every response (anonymized as Response A, B, C, etc.) and produced rankings. Model names are shown in bold below for readability, but the original evaluation used anonymous labels.
stage2.aggDesc: Combined results across all peer evaluations (a lower score is better):

stage3.title: Stage 3: Final council answer
stage3.rankingNote: Lower score = ranked higher by peers.

service.p: AI Delphi Council is an AI multi-model deliberation platform. It routes your queries to several third-party large language models via OpenRouter, then collects independent answers, runs an anonymous peer review and ranking, and produces a chairman synthesis. The Service is an orchestration layer and does not itself create the underlying model outputs.

acceptableUse.p: You agree not to use the Service to submit unlawful, harmful, abusive, infringing or deceptive content; to attempt to disrupt, overload or reverse-engineer the Service; to violate the rights of others; or to generate content prohibited by the policies of the underlying AI providers. Credits consumed per council request are governed by the pricing displayed in your account.

providers.h: 5. Third-party AI providers & no guarantee of accuracy

You are solely responsible for reviewing and verifying any output before relying on it.
